question: What inauspicious outcomes are signified by marks appearing on the chin and ear?
premises: A mark located on the chin signifies loss of kin.
A mark located on the ear signifies destruction of the shoulder.
Specific bodily locations correspond to specific inauspicious outcomes.
inference: Marks on the chin and ear respectively foretell the loss of kin and the destruction of the shoulder.
uncertainties: The exact nature of skandhavināśanam as physical injury or broader ruin is not specified.
plain_english: On the chin there may be loss of kin, and on the ear there may be destruction of the shoulder.
